name: Fujiwara no Sadayori
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 64); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1004.

poems.title: So thickly lies the morning mist
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sadayori
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 64
poems.text:
So thickly lies the morning mist,
That I can scarcely see
The fish-nets on the river bank,
The River of Uji,
Past daybreak though it be.

poems.title: 64. 朝ぼらけ 宇治の川霧 絶えだえに (Asaborake Uji no kawagiri taedae ni)
poems.author: Fujiwara no Sadayori
poems.collection: 小倉百人一首 (Ogura Hyakunin Isshu)
poems.note: Classical Japanese; from the 千載集
poems.text:
朝ぼらけ 宇治の川霧 絶えだえに
あらはれ渡る 瀬々の網代木
